entries.summary: Created .build memory and completed Phase 0 route/auth consolidation
Completed Operating Theatre, Surgical Scheduling, Anesthesia & PACU Subsystem with 14/14 tests passing and 133/133 full regression passing

Completed Health Insurance Authority (NHIA) Claims Batches, E-Claims Submission, Electronic Adjudication & Reconciliation Subsystem with 15/15 tests passing and 250/250 full regression passing across all 20 test suites

Completed Critical Security, Authentication, Session Revocation, Developer Portal Isolation (/developer-portal + MFA), Global Tenant Access Guard with Audited Patient Safety Emergency Bypass, Health Endpoint Hardening, Production-Safe Idempotent Bootstrap, and Git Secret Hygiene. Verified 26/26 Jest suites (320/320 tests passing), Frontend Vite build (exit code 0), and zero credential leaks.

Removed 6 obsolete/duplicate targets (Backend/src/modules/aaaa, Backend/controllers, Backend/developer-console, Backend/src/developer-center, portrait_super_admin.jpg, public/index.js), removed 5,527 remaining zero-byte placeholder files, pruned 2,333 empty placeholder directories (0 zero-byte files and 0 empty dirs left across 371 active dirs / 584 real files), unified all 3 permission vocabularies into 82 canonical permissions in Backend/src/core/security/permissions.js, cleaned all Loan System CSS references, and populated favicon.ico, manifest.json, robots.txt, database/ERD.md, documentation/DISASTER_RECOVERY.md, and Backend engineering docs. Verified 27/27 Jest suites (325/325 tests passing) and Vite production build.

Implemented 5 new PostgreSQL Prisma models (DentalRecord, EyeClinicRecord, IcuMonitoringRecord, ClinicalSafetyOverride, AiClinicalSuggestion — 121 total models), 5 Backend API modules (/dental, /eye-clinic, /icu, /clinical-safety, /ai-clinical), immutable Drug Interaction & Allergy Guardrails wired into doctor prescribing and pharmacy dispensing, 4-step Human Approval Workflow for AI Clinical Assistance, and 4 modular real-life-imagery React workspaces (DentalClinicView, EyeClinicView, IcuVitalsView, AiSafetyCenterView). Verified 28/28 Jest suites (330/330 tests passing) and Vite production build (1,598 modules).

Added 3 PostgreSQL Prisma models (HospitalMeeting, HospitalDocument, FacilityTask — 124 total models), 3 Backend API modules (/meetings, /documents, /facility), GET /patients/me/dashboard self-service endpoint, and 6 standalone real-life-imagery React workspaces (LaboratoryView, RadiologyPacsView, BillingPaymentsView, PatientPortalView, ExecutiveAdminBiView, OperationsSuiteView) with exact per-role portal routing across all 16 Blueprint roles. Verified 29/29 Jest suites (334/334 tests passing) and Vite production build (1,604 modules).
